newsitem.title: JAPAN: Weak yen may not hurt Japan business, economy-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Weak yen may not hurt Japan business, economy-MITI.

text.p: The yen's weakness is not necessarily affecting the Japanese economy or businesses, Vice Trade Minister Tsutomu Makino said on Thursday.
Asked about the recent weakness in the yen, Makino told reporters: "I will not comment on the levels, but I get the impression that the movements are sharp."
He added: "I don't necessarily see bad effects on the economy and businesses. The Group of Seven (G7) meeting on February 8 will probably discuss how the countries view the current situation."
